scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --dir frontend dev" "cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" --names "frontend,backend" --prefix-colors "blue,green"
scripts.lint: cd frontend && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && cd ../backend && ruff check src/ && black --check src/
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && cd backend && python -m pytest
scripts.seed:demo: echo "Non implémenté - sera ajouté dans la spec 06"
